text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After finishing her Debut race, Fine 
Motion was left utterly speechless with 
emotion. And so, her desire to run in more 
races grew even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, her current goal is to keep 
building up her training so she can 
withstand fierce races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer decided to let her gain 
experience while thinking about which 
races she wanted to target. For now, the 
priority was building up her record and 
fan base...!
